checks.text: Clicking the "Start" button begins a 25-minute countdown.
Clicking "Pause" stops the countdown and shows "Paused" on the button.
Clicking "Reset" stops the countdown and returns to 25:00.
After 25 minutes, the timer switches to a 5-minute break.
Clicking "Switch" toggles between work and break modes.
Typing "30" in the work time field changes the interval to 30 minutes.
The timer updates every second while running.
Closing the tab and reopening the app retains the last interval setting.
Reload keeps the current interval and state (e.g., "25:00" or "5:00").
